name: Standing Hip Abduction

instructions.description: Stand tall beside a wall or chair and hold it lightly for balance.
Shift weight onto the inside leg while keeping the pelvis level.
Move the outside leg straight out to the side without leaning the trunk.
Lower the leg with control and repeat before switching sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use slow controlled lifts without swinging.

variations.variationDescription: Trains similar hip abductors in an upright weight-bearing position.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Add a light ankle loop band to increase resistance.

commentsNotes: Do not hike the hip to lift higher.
